description: Search available functions for the unmet external capabilities of a step (usually one to six, at most eighteen per call); returns compact function-id candidates grouped by worker, plus matching installed skill documents under `skills` and existing observers under `observers`.

capabilities.description: Non-empty capability searches derived from the goal and current execution state, usually one to six and at most eighteen per call (searched in batches of six). For one search at each decision point, include all unmet external capabilities once. Exclude intrinsic reasoning, summarization, planning, or formatting, and do not repeat needs already represented or satisfied. Requests to summarize provided text or content are ignored. Write every entry in English, translating non-English user requests while preserving proper names, URLs, and function IDs.

description.description: First description sentence, capped at 160 bytes.

InstallCall.description: A ready-made `compose::add` target and payload. Under agent-call exposure, the caller still supplies the wrapper's user-facing `description`.

InstallableWorker.description: A registry worker that is NOT installed but carries functions matching the requested capabilities. `name` is the registry slug `compose::add` installs.

functions.description: Compact candidates only. If the remaining task needs these functions, reuse their IDs and fetch the required contracts through `engine::functions::info`.

install.description: The `compose::add` target and payload; agent-call callers add `description`.

ObserverCandidate.description: An observer (an `engine::observers::list` row) whose observed event, schedule, or hook matches a requested capability.

args.description: The observer's args (cron expression, route, hook priority, …).

target.description: The function the observer runs; inspect it with `engine::functions::info`.

worker_name.description: The worker that created the observer.

SkillCandidate.description: An installed skill document (a `directory::skills::list` row) whose content matches a requested capability.

description.description: First description sentence, capped at 160 bytes.

id.description: Pass to `directory::skills::get { id }` to read the document.

installable.description: Matching workers from the private registry. Their functions are NOT callable until the worker is installed.

observers.description: Observers matching the capabilities: what already runs a function on their events, schedules, or hooks.

search_mode.description: The search mode that actually produced these results: `judge`, `hybrid` or `lexical`. It can be lower than the configured mode when a batch fell back (judge worker absent or failing, or no local model).

skills.description: Installed skill documents matching the capabilities. Read one with `directory::skills::get { id }` before acting on it.
